newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BULGARIA, October 14-20 - Bourgas - Fifty-three vessels in port operating of which 27 loading (3 fish meal, 6 steel, 4 metal, 1 copper, 2 general cargo, 1 timber, 4 chemicals, 2 gasoil, 1 ammonium nitrate, 1 urea, 1 bentonite, 1 empty vessel). 21 Discharging (2 zinc concentrate, 2 fish meal, 3 salt, 3 petrol, 2 coal, 3 iron ore, 2 containers, 2 sugar, 1 cars, 1 fertiliser). 5 Discharging/loading (1 salt/steel, 1 salt/general cargo, 1 cars, 1 containers, 1 zinc concentrate/steel). 15 Vessels waiting in roads of which 11 to load (2 general cargo, 1 metal, 3 ammonium nitrate, 1 alcohol, 1 benzene, 3 empty vessels). 3 To discharge (2 sugar, 1 iron ore), 1 to change documents. 15 Vessels due of which 10 to load (1 ammonium nitrate, 2 general cargo, 2 pipes, 1 benzene, 1 coils, 1 copper concentrate, 1 chemicals, 1 gasoil). 5 To discharge (1 wheat, 2 coal, 1 ethanol, 1 containers).

Varna - Varna east, Varna west, Balchik, Teps - 30 Vessels in port operating of which 1 loading (2 tsp, 2 cement, 1 scrap, 1 ply-wood/timber, 4 soda, 1 cigarettes/cognac, 2 urea, 1 kaolin, 1 glass, 2 quartz sand, 1 clinker). 5 Discharging (4 coal, 1 trucks). 5 Discharging/loading containers, 2 discharging/loading trucks/containers. 7 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load (1 urea, 2 sugar). 1 To discharge coal, 3 cargo not nominated. October 21 - No labour problems reported. Varna - Varna east - 3 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth. 1 Waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge, 3 awaiting orders. Varna west - 8 Vessels loading at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge.

Varna Lesport - 2 Vessels loading at anchorage, 1 discharging at berth. Bourgas - Bourgas east - 7 Vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at anchorage, 15 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharge. 9 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 15 due with delays expected. Bourgas west - 2 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. Tanker port - 1 Vessel discharging at berth.

CROATIA, October 21 - Rijeka - One vessel discharging at berth, 5 loading at berth, 6 under repair/dry-docked. 1 Vessel inoperative at berth, 1 anchored, 6 due with delays expected. Split - Two vessels discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth. Ploce - Two vessels discharging at berth. Pula, Rasa, Zadar, Sibenik, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, October 22 - Limassol - Three container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 3 conventional vessels discharging at berth, 1 ro/ro discharging/loading at berth. 1 Vessel waiting at anchor to discharge/load. 12 Vessels due 23/10 of which 4 containers, 2 conventional vessels, 5 passenger vessels, 1 cruise vessel. Larnaca - One container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging at berth. 2 Vessels due 23/10 of which 1 containers, 1 conventional.

ESTONIA, October 21 - All ports working normally. Tallinn - City port - 3 Vessels due. Kopli - 2 Vessels berthed loading sawn timber, 3 discharging at berth (1 meat, 1 beans, 1 potatoes). 9 Vessels due. Muuga - 3 Vessels loading at berth (1 black oil, 1 peat, 1 fertiliser). 4 Grain vessels discharging at berth. 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 3 ferries. 4 Vessels due. Parnu - Four vessels loading at berth (3 peat, 1 granular wood), 2 vessels due.

ITALY, October 22 - Naples - One container vessel etb over the next few days. Gaeta, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa - Commercial port - 1 Vessel in roads, no delays. 34 Vessels berthed, 7 dry-docked. Multedo - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 4 vessels berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 4 vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 8 vessels berthed, 5 under repair. Leghorn - Five vessels in roads, 33 berthed. Civitavecchia - Two vessels in roads. Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo - No vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta - Oil harbour - 2 Vessels in roads, 3 berthed. Syracuse - Oil harbour - 1 Vessel in roads, 1 berthed. Sarroch - No information received. Taranto - Eight vessels in roads totalling 678,282 dwt.) Ravenna - Seven vessels in roads. Ancona/Falconara - One vessel in roads. Venice - Three vessels in roads. Trieste - Seven vessels in roads. Approx. 4 days delay expected for berthing at oil terminal.

LATVIA, October 22 - No strikes at any port. Riga - Fifteen vessels in port of which 13 operating as follows, 5 timber loaders, 1 fertiliser loader, 1 metal loader, 2 tanker loaders, 1 scrap metal loader, 2 container loaders, 1 fish discharger, 2 vessels waiting. No delays, 18 vessels due. Ventspils - Five vessels in port, all operating, of which 1 steel loader, 2 steel billets loaders, 1 ferrous metal loader, 1 banana discharger. No vessels waiting, no delays, 13 vessels due. Iepaja - Seven vessels in port, all operating, no vessels waiting. No delays, 1 vessel due.

LITHUANIA, October 21 - Klaipeda - Nine vessels loading (1 oil, 1 potash, 2 fertiliser, 1 timber, 3 metal, 1 steel pieces), 4 discharging (3 fish, 1 grain). 1 Vessel loading/discharging. 5 Vessels in roads, 27 due.

POLAND, October 22 - Gdynia - Ten vessels operating of which 3 loading at berth (1 coal, 1 bulker, 1 general cargo). 7 Discharging at berth (2 general cargo, 5 grain). 5 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 35 vessels due. Gdansk - Ten vessels operating of which 5 loading at berth (1 coal, 3 general cargo, 1 bulker). 5 Discharging (1 bulker, 1 tanker, 1 grain, 2 general cargo). 3 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 2 awaiting turn of which 1 coal, 1 grain. 25 Vessels due. Szczecin, October 23 - Fifty-four vessels loading at berth, 48 discharging at berth, 2 vessels waiting at anchor to load, 4 waiting to discharge. 2 Vessels bunkering, 8 under repair/dry-docked, 96 vessels due.

PORTUGAL, October 21 - Leixoes - Eight vessels operating of which general cargo, 4 containers. No vessels awaiting berths. Vacant places, 11 piers with cranes, 2 piers without cranes. October 22 - Setubal - Nine vessels operating of which 5 loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth. 6 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 14 due of which 8 to discharge, 4 to load, 2 for repair/dry-dock.

ROMANIA, October 22 - Constantza - Forty-five vessels operating of which 17 general cargo (14 loading, 3 discharging), 12 bulkers (3 loading, 9 discharging), 12 bagged chemicals (11 loading, 1 discharging), 1 tanker, 1 bagged cement loading, 2 containers discharging. 9 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 general cargo (3 to load, 1 to discharge), 3 bulkers, 2 bagged chemicals (all to load). Constantza south (Agigea) - Three vessels operating of which 2 general cargo (1 loading, 1 discharging), 1 bulker discharging. Mangalia - No vessels loading, none waiting. Midia - One livestock carrier loading.

RUSSIA - Baltic ports - St. Petersburg - October 21 - Twenty vessels operating of which 15 loading (4 non-ferrous metals, 1 timber, 1 containers, 7 fertiliser, 1 scrap, 1 general cargo). 5 Discharging (2 pipes, 1 malt, 1 containers, 1 fruit). 9 Vessels waiting, 9 due. October 22 - No strikes at any port. Kaliningrad - Nine vessels in port of which 7 operating as follows, 2 fertiliser loaders, 2 coal loaders, 2 scrap metal loaders, 1 aluminium loader. 2 Vessels waiting, no delays, 2 vessels due. Vyborg - Two vessels in port, both operating, no vessels waiting, no delays, 8 vessels due.

Far Eastern ports - October 22 - No strikes/congestion/delays at any port. Vladivostok - Eleven vessels in port of which 7 loading (1 metal, 1 timber, 2 general cargo, 1 wood-pulp, 2 containers), 1 passenger vessel. 3 Vessels waiting. Nakhodka - Eleven vessels in port of which 7 loading (6 metal, 1 timber), 4 waiting. Vostochny - Nine vessels in port of which 6 loading (2 coal, 1 metal, 1 aluminium, 1 timber, 1 clinker). 1 Loading/dischar-ging containers, 2 vessels waiting. Posyet - No vessels. Khasan - Three vessels in port of which 2 loading metals, 1 waiting.

Black Sea ports - Novorossiysk - October 21 - Fourteen vessels in port operating of which 10 loading (1 cement, 1 general cargo, 5 steel, 1 copper, 1 cars, 1 seeds). 4 Discharging (1 rice, 1 equipment, 2 various). 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 to load seeds, 3 to discharge rice, 1 to discharge containers. 28 Vessels due of which 25 to load (1 scrap, 1 cast iron, 15 steel, 1 copper, 1 zinc, 1 col. metals, 2 seeds, 1 sugar beet, 1 coal, 1 sawn wood). 3 To discharge (1 sugar, 1 zinc concentrate, 1 rice). Oil terminal - 1 Vessel loading fuel oil, 1 in roads waiting to load crude oil, 11 due of which 6 to load crude oil, 3 diesel oil, 2 fuel oil.

SLOVENIA, October 21 - Koper - Eleven vessels berthed of which 2 bulk carriers loading (grain, coal). 3 Bulk carriers discharging (grain, chrome ore, perlite). 3 General cargo vessels loading (steel, sawn timber). 2 Livestock vessels loading bulls, 1 ferry loading/discharging, no delays expected. 10 Vessels due over the next 2 days of which 4 containers to load/discharge. 3 Vessels to load (1 grain, 1 sawn timber, 1 cars), 3 to discharge (2 phosphates/gra, 1 bananas).

SPAIN, October 21 - Bilbao - Refinery labour are on strike from 19/10 until 06.00 hrs. 25/10, which may affect tanker operations. Nineteen dry cargo vessels operating of which 8 discharging, 8 loading, 3 loading/discharging. Sagunto - Twenty-one vessels operating of which 4 ro/ros discharging/loading. 1 Vessel discharging/loading surgical products. 7 Vessels loading (3 surgical products, 2 fertiliser, 1 timber, 1 onions). 9 Discharging (7 surgical products, 1 liquid ammonia, 1 bananas). No vessels berthed outside commercial wharf, no berthing delays. October 22 - Aviles - Six vessels in port of which 4 discharging (2 scrap, 1 phosphate, 1 zinc concentrates). 2 Loading (1 sulphuric acid, 1 tar). Gijon - Six vessels in port of which 3 discharging (2 petroleum products, 1 wood). 3 Loading (1 cement, 2 steel products).

Stevedores in Aviles and Gijon threatening to go on intermittent strike from 28 October until 28 November. Pasajes - Nineteen vessels in port of which 14 discharging (6 scrap, 1 steel, 1 petcoke, sawn timber, 1 fertiliser, 1 cold fish, 1 potash, 2 minerals). 3 Loading steel, 2 discharging/loading cars, no delays.

TURKEY, October 22 - Istanbul - Haydar-Pasa - 13 vessels operating of which 7 containers, 5 dry cargo, 1 ro/ro, no berthing delays except for heavy lift cargoes. Galata - 12 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested, Ambarli - 14 Vessels operating, no berthing delays. Mersin - 22 Vessels operating of which 15 loading (3 legumes, 1 soda/chrome, 1 lead, 2 cement, 1 chrome, 3 citrus, 1 corn oil, 1 pumice stone, 1 livestock, 1 general cargo). 1 Discharging bulk oil. 6 Loading/discharging (2 vehicles, 3 containers, 1 containers/profiles). 12 Vessels awaiting orders. Free Zone piers - 1 Vessel loading rice. Seka - No vessels. Iskenderun - One vessel discharging fuel oil, 1 loading citrus, 1 vessel anchored. Sariseki terminal - 1 Vessel discharging phosphate, 1 loading clinker. Yazicilar - 1 Vessel discharging corn oil, 1 discharging steel billets. Isdemir terminal - 1 Vessel discharging coal, 1 loading iron for building, 1 vessel anchored. Mersin - 21 Vessels operating of which 11 loading (2 citrus, 3 pulses, 1 lead, 1 livestock, 1 chrome, 2 cement, 1 pumice stone). 5 Discharging (1 general cargo, 1 rice, 1 oil, 1 paraxylene, 1 ammonia), 1 loading/discharging vehicles, 4 container vessels, 16 vessels anchored.

UKRAINE, Oct 21 - Mariupol - Seven vessels in port operating of which 6 loading (3 steel, 1 ferrous metal, 2 coal). 1 Discharging zinc. 3 Vessels waiting in roads of which 2 to load (1 urea, 1 steel coils), 1 to discharge steel plates. 31 Vessels due of which 20 to load (2 coal, 11 steel, 4 fertiliser, 1 flour, 1 sunflower seed, 1 ferrous metal). 5 To discharge (2 flourspar, 1 alumina, 1 bauxite, 1 coal). 1 To discharge/load containers/steel. 4 To discharge/load containers. 1 Cargo not nominated. Odessa - 16 Vessels in port operating of which 7 loading (2 metals, 1 sugar, 1 steel, 1 oil, 1 fuel oil, 1 containers), 2 discharging (1 citrus, 1 laurel leaves), 3 passenger vessels, 2 under repair, 2 waiting. 4 Vessels in roads of which 3 waiting, 1 bunkering. 15 Vessels due of which 11 to load (7 metals, 1 sugar, 1 urea, 1 paper, 1 gasoil), 1 to discharge sugar, 2 to discharge/load containers, 1 passger vessel. October 22 - Odessa - Steel cargoes (loading), 4 vessels berthed, 1 anchored, 5 due. Containers, 2 vessels due. Grain cargoes (loading), 1 vessel berthed. Sugar dischargers, 1 vessel due. Tankers (loading), 1 vessel berthed, 1 due. General cargo, 1 vessel berthed, 1 due. Ilichevsk - Steel cargoes (loading), 8 vessels berthed, 1 anchored. Containers, 1 vessel berthed. Tankers (discharging), 1 berthed. General cargo, 1 vessel berthed, 1 anchored, 1 ferry.

YUGOSLAVIA, Octtober 22 - Bar - Six vessels berthed of which 5 discharging (3 bananas, 1 vitriol copper, 1 iron bars), 1 loading lead/zinc, 4 ferries on the routes Bar-Bari-Bar, Bar-Koper-Trieste-Bar, no delays. Zelenika (Bijela) - Four vessels under repair, no delays.
